summary: This plugin bridges GitHub Copilot into DeepSeek Harness as a copilot model provider and provides session-level chat access plus commands to check connection status and available models.

classificationSuggestion.reason: Classified as an external-services integration plugin because it primarily bridges GitHub Copilot into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider for chat usage, with DSH plugin entry points and commands for checking status, listing models, and stopping runtime. The README and package metadata show it relies on GitHub authentication tokens and external LLM dependencies, so moderate risk is present from credential handling and outbound service access; no strong evidence indicates additional high-impact local automation or execution capabilities beyond this bridge.
